header_comments: PolicyDecision represents the outcome of a policy evaluation.
inline_comments: TrustConfig holds configuration for the TrustManager.
TierThresholds defines score boundaries for trust tiers.
AuditFilter controls which entries are returned by GetEntries.
GovernanceResult is the outcome of ExecuteWithGovernance.
BackendDecision is the normalized result from an external policy backend.
ExternalPolicyBackend evaluates execution contexts using a non-native policy engine.
WithCapabilities sets capabilities on identity generation.
WithTrustConfig overrides the default trust configuration.
